comments.body:
Implementation pushed as Gerrit change 1794 (commit 2081400e85d, subject: Add administrative close dispositions).

Withheld-oracle TDD: tests/unit/test_administrative_close_dispositions.py written first — RED proof 34 failed / 8 passed on unmodified code (passers are regression pins). All 43 now GREEN; adjacent suites (transition/close/disposition/precheck/txn/reducer/canary/schema, 568 tests) green. Sanctioned test updates: 738a verdict parametrization split into replacement-bearing vs reason-only classes (equality drift-guard intact, both sets now 6 members); _verification_fail_message call sites gained the new ticket_type arg.

Implementation per the certified plan: (1) vocabulary +obsolete/superseded/wontfix in CLOSE_CLASSES/CloseClass/both schemas; (2) ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES + REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES in close_disposition.py; (3) shared write-side guard txn.close_class_refusal (gate-independent, force cannot bypass vocabulary), --reason reused and persisted present-only as close_reason (distinct from force_close_reason), threaded CLI->transition_compute->close_ticket->transition_core, reducer fold, TicketState typing; (4) precheck: _administrative_disposition guard (reason-only mints verdict from class+close_reason, skips AC/file-impact/verifier), _ensure_duplicate_close_is_linked widened to {duplicate, superseded} on any type; (5) verdict(close_reason=) + decorate_manifest signs 'disposition: <class> reason: <text>'; (6) FAIL message enumerates per-type --class values, force close hints --class on stderr; (7) docs: ticket-model.md administrative-dispositions section, user-guide.md, transition help + cli-reference regenerated.

Mutation pass: 11 targeted hand-mutants (admin-set member drop, reason-less mint, manifest reason-line drop, non-bug vocabulary bypass, reason-requirement drop, stamp/fold drops, plain-reason guard bypass, superseded link-demand revert, enumeration drop, hint drop) — 11/11 KILLED.

Gates: make lint clean (complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0), make typecheck clean (541 files). Awaiting LLM-Review + Verified on change 1794; not closing until merged.

compiled_state.description:
## Problem
7-day store mining (2026-08-07..14) found 33 FORCE_CLOSE audit records, ~25 of them ADMINISTRATIVE closes — duplicate, obsolete, wontfix, stale-premise — where completing the described work is not the intent, so the completion verifier can never PASS them and operators reach for --force. A narrow attested-disposition path exists but is doubly scoped down: (a) class set — `close_disposition.DISPOSITION_CLASSES` = {duplicate, not_a_bug, escalated} only; (b) ticket type — close_precheck.py:64 gates the path to bugs, so an obsolete task/story/epic has NO truthful exit today. And the completion-FAIL message never mentions the path that exists: "it offered only 'complete the work' or '[operator-attested]' — attesting would have been a FALSE claim" (9b70). This is the single largest FORCE_CLOSE class.

## Fix (extends the EXISTING --class mechanism; no new flag)
1. Vocabulary: add obsolete (premise no longer holds; reason required), superseded (replaced by a named live ticket), wontfix (deliberate decision; reason required) to the single-sourced `CLOSE_CLASSES` (txn.py:168). Enumerated co-edits: common.schema.json#/$defs/close_class enum+description (same order), ticket_state.schema.json close_class description (:196-198), `close_disposition.DISPOSITION_CLASSES` AND `close_precheck._NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES` (both gain the three; their equality drift-guard tests/unit/test_close_disposition_attestation_738a.py:26 updated), the `transition.py` parser (existing `--class` gains the values; NO new --disposition flag), and `types.py` CloseClass.
2. Administrative subset, single-sourced: a new frozenset `close_disposition.ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES = {duplicate, obsolete, superseded, wontfix}` — the classes valid on NON-BUG closes (not_a_bug/escalated stay bug-only vocabulary). Drift-guarded by a test asserting ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES < DISPOSITION_CLASSES and exact membership.
3. Write-side enforcement (gate-independent — cannot be skipped by --force or a disabled completion gate): extend `txn.transition_core`'s close-class guard (txn.py:260, today `ticket_type == "bug"`-gated) so (a) a non-bug close MAY carry --class only from ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES (anything else refused naming the allowed values — the enforcement point for not_a_bug/escalated staying bug-only); (b) obsolete/wontfix REQUIRE a reason (refusal when missing). The reason REUSES the existing `--reason` flag (transition.py:152-158) — today force-only, with an active refusal on plain transitions ("--reason is only meaningful with --force", transition.py:549-554): that guard is AMENDED to also admit `--reason` WITHOUT `--force` when the close carries a reason-capable administrative class (obsolete/wontfix; unchanged refusal otherwise). On a non-force administrative close the reason persists as a NEW `close_reason` key on the close STATUS event (present-only, mirroring close_class at txn.py:287; NOT force_close_reason, which stays the --force channel's fold). Threading co-edits: transition_core (and transition_compute) gain a `close_reason` parameter threaded from close_ticket/the CLI parse; reducer fold `_fold_close_metadata` (reducer/_processors_status.py:49) folds it; types.py ticket-state TypedDict (:138 area) + ticket_state.schema.json declare it.
4. Verification skip for administrative closes: a NEW explicit `_completion_precheck` branch — a close whose class is a reason-only ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASS (obsolete/wontfix, no replacement link) skips the AC/file-impact/billable-verifier checks and returns the disposition verdict (widening `_has_live_replacement_link`'s type-gate at close_precheck.py:64 alone would NOT route them: that function detects replacement links, which reason-only classes lack). Replacement-bearing classes route through the widened :64 gate; `_ensure_duplicate_close_is_linked` (close_precheck.py:139, called at :508) widens from duplicate-only to {duplicate, superseded} so both demand a live replacement link (existing `find_replacement`, close_disposition.py:47); the plan-review claim gate is untouched.
5. Attestation for reason-only classes: `close_disposition.verdict()` (:92) today returns None unless find_replacement resolves a live ticket, and `decorate_manifest` (:114) signs that replacement — so obsolete/wontfix as-written would close UNSIGNED (the 738a trap). Extend both signatures: verdict() gains a `close_reason: str = ""` parameter (threaded from its precheck call site) and mints the reason-only verdict from (class + close_reason); decorate_manifest signs a `disposition: <class> reason: <text>` line for reason-only classes; replacement-bearing classes unchanged.
6. Discoverability: the close refusal surface is `close_precheck`'s CommandError assembly, which HAS ticket context — it appends the applicable-class enumeration (`--class` values valid for THIS ticket_type) to the completion-FAIL/refusal message; the static COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE constant stays generic (no per-ticket data in a module constant). The 9b70 incident is the RED oracle: a wontfix-shaped ticket's failure message must present a truthful exit.
7. Migration: existing FORCE_CLOSE records stay as-is; new administrative closes should have no reason to use --force.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The three new classes appear in every single-sourced consumer — txn.CLOSE_CLASSES, common.schema.json + ticket_state.schema.json, DISPOSITION_CLASSES, _NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES, types.py CloseClass — with the 738a equality drift-guard updated; ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES exists in close_disposition with exact membership {duplicate, obsolete, superseded, wontfix} and a subset drift-guard test.
- [ ] Non-bug tickets (task/story/epic fixture each) close with an administrative class without completion verification — reason-only classes via the new explicit precheck branch returning the disposition verdict; a non-bug close with not_a_bug/escalated (or any non-administrative class) is REFUSED in txn.transition_core naming allowed values; bug closes keep today's behavior.
- [ ] obsolete/wontfix demand a reason (write-side refusal when missing, enforced in transition_core even with the completion gate off); the transition.py:549-554 "--reason only with --force" guard admits --reason WITHOUT --force for these classes (refusal unchanged otherwise); the reason threads close_ticket -> transition_core/transition_compute, persists as close_reason on the close event (distinct from force_close_reason), folds via _fold_close_metadata into reduced state, and typechecks (types.py); superseded/duplicate demand a live replacement link (_ensure_duplicate_close_is_linked widened); store-event tests per class.
- [ ] A reason-only disposition close mints a SIGNED disposition attestation whose manifest carries the class+reason line; replacement-bearing closes keep the replacement line; an unsigned close for a valid disposition is RED.
- [ ] The close_precheck refusal/FAIL message enumerates the applicable --class values for the ticket's type; message test asserts the 9b70 wontfix scenario is offered a truthful exit; --force on an administrative-shaped close hints the disposition alternative.
- [ ] docs (ticket-model / user-guide) document the widened path; `make lint`/`make typecheck` clean; lands via Gerrit (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1).
compiled_state.title: Sanctioned administrative-disposition close path (duplicate/obsolete/superseded/wontfix/...) discoverable from the close-gate failure message
